title: The How the Market Song Goes
youtube_title: The How the Market Song Goes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Zola about a market song that has a silly middle you must not skip. Zola wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
